Place ViGEmBus_Setup.exe here before building the Windows installer. The installer runs it silently
when the ViGEmBus driver (used by the joystick tool) is not already installed.

Download ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe from
https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases/tag/v1.22.0 and rename it to ViGEmBus_Setup.exe
(BSD-3-Clause; keep the signature intact). Without the file the installer simply skips this step.
